name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.infinitescrollview
description: InfiniteScrollView is made for Unity extension, that support use as less as possible gameObject count to achieve large infinite scrolling content. Developed by native UGUI system, no any magical code inside, so you can easily modify and extend by yourself.

samples.description: Vertical list in Normal and Reverse data order: pool initialization, Add/Remove/Refresh, snapping, and scroll-state queries driven by a GUI test panel.
Horizontal list in Normal and Reverse data order with the same data operations as the vertical demo, driven by a GUI test panel.
Grid layouts in vertical and horizontal directions (Normal and Reverse): columnCount/rowCount/spacing setup and grid cell prefabs, driven by a GUI test panel.
Tab-page pattern: a horizontal paged scroll view with tab switching via Snap, page cells, and per-page data.
Chat-room list with dynamic cell heights: measuring text into InfiniteCellData.cellSize, appending messages, Refresh, and SnapLast auto-scroll to the newest entry.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the InfiniteScrollView: scroll-view variants, InfiniteCell lifecycle, InfiniteCellData sizing, data operations, and snapping. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
